children: Market analysts say Wall Street is not yet prepared to make a large-scale short bet against AI. According to Odaily, hedge fund manager and short seller Steve Eisman, who became known for betting on the 2008 financial crisis, has emerged as one of Wall Street's critics of the AI boom, but he is still unwilling to commit significant capital to shorting AI. Eisman said, "I am not ready to make a big short judgment here."

title: Steve Eisman Says He Is Not Ready to Make a Big Short Bet Against AI
